title: The Equivalence Problem for Generalized Airy Operators
summary: In this paper, we establish degree obstructions to the equivalence of generalized Airy operators of the same type. As an application, we answer a question posed by Nicholas M. Katz in Inventiones Mathematicae (87, pp. 13-61,1987). The main results of Sections 3 and 4 were obtained through a close interactive collaboration between the authors and the artificial intelligence agent system MechMath Agent Team (MMAT).
